```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           ol.order_id,
           pv.id               AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
), sets AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           GROUPING(order_id, variant_id) AS gs,
           sum(quantity)                  AS q,
           sum(line_total_cents)          AS r
      FROM base
     GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((product_id, order_id), (product_id, variant_id))
), agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE gs = 1)         AS order_count,
           (sum(q) FILTER (WHERE gs = 1))::bigint AS quantity,
           sum(r) FILTER (WHERE gs = 1)           AS revenue_cents,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE gs = 2)         AS variant_count
      FROM sets
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       a.order_count,
       a.quantity,
       a.revenue_cents,
       a.variant_count
  FROM agg a
  JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id
 ORDER BY a.quantity DESC, a.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De twee `count(DISTINCT ...)` dwongen een brede sortering op (p.id, o.id) af, inclusief alle productkolommen, die naar schijf spilde. Nu worden de distinct-tellingen via hash-gebaseerde GROUPING SETS op smalle uuid-sleutels berekend. Daarna wordt per product opgeteld, en pas op het einde worden de ~1.750 resultaatrijen aan `products` gekoppeld. De cast naar `bigint` houdt het type van `quantity` gelijk aan het origineel: in twee stappen zou `sum(bigint)` anders `numeric` opleveren.
